proposed_widenings.name: modify_death_save_threshold
proposed_widenings.justification: Defy Death's '18-20 on a Death Saving Throw counts as a 20' requires treating a range of natural die results as the maximum result (20 = regain 1 HP, per SRD). The existing modify_crit_range atom only applies to attack rolls and encodes a different semantic (crit hit). Death saves have entirely distinct SRD mechanics unrelated to attack crits; there is no analogous threshold-replacement atom scoped to death saves.
proposed_widenings.evidence: when you roll 18–20 on a Death Saving Throw, you gain the benefit of rolling a 20 on it

proposed_widenings.name: PassiveOperation.trigger.on_attached_turn_start
proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally fires 'at the start of each of your turns', but PassiveOperation.trigger only supports elapsed_time (hours or days). Turn-start cadence is a common SRD class-feature pattern (see also Aura of Life, Heroism, Spirit Guardians) and needs to be a valid trigger kind for passive class-feature operations.
proposed_widenings.evidence: At the start of each of your turns, you regain Hit Points equal to 5 plus your Constitution modifier if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingPredicate.at_bloodied
proposed_widenings.justification: Heroic Rally's heal is conditional on being Bloodied, which is a relative HP threshold (≤ half max HP) defined in SRD 5.2.1 Rules Glossary. The current OngoingPredicate uses a fixed integer comparison (at_hp_threshold with lte/eq/gte), which cannot express a percentage-of-maximum threshold. A dedicated 'bloodied' predicate variant (or a ratio-based hp_threshold) is needed.
proposed_widenings.evidence: if you are Bloodied and have at least 1 Hit Point

notes: Survivor is a composite feature with two named sub-features. The advantage-on-death-saves half of Defy Death would encode cleanly as modify_roll_advantage on ["death_saving_throw"]. The 18-20=20 mechanic blocks a clean encoding of Defy Death because no atom exists for 'treat a natural die result range as the maximum result on a death save'. Heroic Rally requires both a turn-start passive trigger (PassiveOperation.trigger only supports elapsed_time) and a Bloodied (relative HP ≤ 50% max) predicate (OngoingPredicate only supports fixed integer comparisons). Three widenings are needed across both sub-features; the unit does not 'mostly fit with an omitted rider' — the core of each sub-feature has a gap.
